sentences.text: JPMorgan now runs one model for fraud detection, authorization prediction and payment retries, a sign that shared transaction data can replace separate payment models.
Barclays processes client emails with Claude in Global Markets, and BNP Paribas is scaling generative AI across banking and mortgage journeys.
JPMorgan also completed a proof of concept in which AI agents automate cash management, FX and fund transfers.
Agentic AI is live elsewhere: Commonwealth Bank uses agents against cyber threats and Scotiabank uses one to review borrowers' financial statements.
Woori Bank uses AI agents in corporate sales, while MYbank and Novo run agents for small business credit and customer queries.
